items.summary_en: Wikimedia Commons Napoleon sent the cipher to General Auguste de Marmont in March 1809 in hopes of warning him about enemy troop positions on the eve of war with Austria. In March 1809, on the precipice of war with the Austrian Empire, French leader Napoleon Bonaparte sent a message to his senior general, Auguste de Marmont. items.title_en: How An Enslaved Woman Named La Malinche Helped Hernán Cortés Topple The Aztec Empire
items.title_zh: 一个名叫拉马林奇的奴隶如何帮助埃尔南·科尔特斯推翻阿兹特克帝国
items.summary_en: Roberto Cueva del Rio/Wikimedia Commons A 20th-century painting of La Malinche and Hernán Cortés speaking with Mesoamerican leaders. La Malinche — also known as Malintzin and Doña Marina — was a Mesoamerican woman who served as a trusted advisor and interpreter to Spanish conquistador Hernán Cortés in the 16th century. She played a key role in Cortés’ conquest of the Aztec Empire, and she’s even been referred to as “the real conqueror of Mexico.” Because of this, many Mexicans have historically viewed La Malinche…
